name: Existing Home Sales
consensus_source: No September 2026 consensus found in a targeted search
read: Existing home sales rose 1.5% m/m to 3.99M SAAR from 3.93M, a partial rebound after a 3.2% drop. Consensus unconfirmed. Closings lag contracts, so this shows past affordability strain, still a low level.

reasons: no consensus available; surprise not assessed
